title: WAAREE Radiance 3.2 kW On-Grid Solar Kit with Installation, Single Phase, Bifacial TOPCon Panels, Inverter, AC/DC Distribution Boxes - Complete Rooftop Solar Solution
description: Package contains key components: bifacial DCR solar modules, 3 kVA on-grid inverter, DCDB & ACDB, and compatible installation accessories (cables, connectors, earthing items). High-Efficiency Panels: Uses advanced Bifacial TOPCon DCR panels, capturing sunlight from both front and rear for improved energy yield and performance On-Grid Inverter: Converts DC power from panels into AC power for household use and seamless grid connection Robust Safety Components: Includes surge protection devices (SPDs), MCBs, earthing kit, lightning protection, and high-quality cables for safety and reliability Installation is included as part of the offering. Additional charges may apply only if extra materials or accessories (such as extended cables or additional components) are required based on site conditions or customer request.

specifications.Included Components: AC Cable, 4C 4 Sqmm Cu Flexible Cable (Inverter to ACDB) x 20 Mtr, MC-4 Connectors, MC4 Compatible Connectors (Male/Female Pair) x 4 Pairs, Lightning Arrestor, Conventional Type 1.1 m High HDG (Min. 80 Micron) x 1 Nos, Earth Rod, L-1.5M D-14mm Cu (Min. 250 Micron) x 3 Nos,, Cable Ties (Nylon), 250 mm UV Protected UL Listed x 1 Pkt, Cable Ties (SS), 300 mm SS304 Fire Proof Halogen Free Self-Locking x 1 Pkt, Insulation Tape, Electrical Insulation Tape (R-B-G Colors) x 1 Set, Cable Dressing Clips, SS 316 without Sharp Edges x 6 Nos, Earthing Chemical, 10 kg Earthing Chemical Fill x 1 Bag, Earth Chamber, 245x245x195 mm PPE Chamber with Cover x 3 Nos, Earthing Cable, 1C 6 Sqmm Cu Flexible (Green) for Module-to-Module x 40 Mtr, Lugs, 6 Sqmm Cu Ring Type Lug x 26 Nos, Nut & Bolts, SS 304 B Nut M4x25 WH PW SW for M2M x 25 Sets, PV Module, BiN-08-560/565/570/575/580 (DCR) x 6 Nos, Inverter (On-Grid), WS On Grid 1 Phase Inverter 3 KVA - Gen4 x 1 Nos, DCDB, 1–6 KW (1 In 1 Out) with SPD 600V (Finder) & MCB 32A x 1 Nos, ACDB, 1–6 KW with Indicator 1 Phase SPD 1+1 (Finder) 25/32A 2P AC MCB (Schneider) x 1 Nos, DC Cable (Red), 1C 4 Sqmm Cu XLPO DC Cable x 30 Mtr, DC Cable (Black), 1C 4 Sqmm Cu XLPO DC Cable x 30 Mtr
specifications.Special Features: Advanced Electrical Safety Protection, Bifacial TOPCon Solar Panel Technology, Complete Rooftop Solar Kit Solution, Grid-Connected On-Grid Power System, High Energy Generation Efficiency
